P1.2.text: We are a global professional services company delivering engineering, design, consulting and infrastructure solutions that solve complex challenges and create lasting impact. Discover Jacobs.

P1.3.text: Shaping the future of life sciences manufacturing

P1.4.text: Jacobs connects pharmaceutical facility design, automation and operations, accelerating the path to autonomous production.

P1.5.text: Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled, end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology challenges.

P1.7.text: We bring together the right services, expertise and technology to deliver forward-thinking and sustainable solutions that are built to last.

P1.8.text: We combine global expertise in flood risk management, digital tools and infrastructure design and delivery to reduce exposure and build long-term resilience.

P1.9.text: From early feasibility and technology selection through to design, delivery and long ‑ term operation, we support the full gas power generation project lifecycle, including natural gas fired power generation and long ‑ term maintenance.

P1.10.text: Engage AI is our AI-enabled platform for managing public input at scale — enabling teams to process, understand and act on feedback faster. What took months now takes days, enabling clear public communications, informed decisions and impactful delivery.

P1.11.text: We bring clarity and confidence to navigate a changing regulatory landscape, strengthening foundations and protecting long-term value to unlock sustainable growth.

P1.12.text: W e deliver projects ranging from targeted system upgrades to major urban transit programs, positioning mass transit as a driver of regeneration and sustainable economic growth.

P1.13.text: Our data center digital twin models real-world system behavior before challenges surface as operational risk — enabling owners, developers and technical teams to reduce uncertainty and make faster, better-informed decisions from early feasibility through live operations.

P1.15.text: Discover how we bring complex projects to life, delivering practical, lasting outcomes for the communities and clients we serve.

P1.16.text: Powering the next generation of AI infrastructure

P1.17.text: Cleaning up the River Thames through the UK’s largest ever water infrastructure program

P1.18.text: Driving economic growth through a smart, green industrial city in India

P1.19.text: Delivering flood protection in the U.S. Midwest with an innovative funding model

P1.20.text: Accelerating smarter growth and service delivery for local government

P1.21.text: Enabling a more resilient and sustainable Great Lakes port

P1.22.text: Creating a therapeutic space that respects culture, ensures patient safety and promotes clinical recovery

P1.23.text: Smart infrastructure at scale: Riyadh’s AI-driven coordination breakthrough

P1.24.text: Jacobs to deploy data center digital twin for NVIDIA’s R&D facility

P1.25.text: Jacobs has been selected by NVIDIA to deploy its Data Center Digital Twin for a large-scale R&D facility in the United States. Under a three-year software-as-a-service agreement, Jacobs will deploy a digital twin environment to enhance operational planning and improve facility performance across one of NVIDIA's most advanced artificial intelligence research and development facilities.

P1.26.text: Jacobs to enhance wastewater system performance for Oklahoma City

P1.27.text: Jacobs has been selected by the Oklahoma City Water Utilities Trust (OCWUT) to provide operations and maintenance (O&M) services for the city’s wastewater facilities and solids management program under a five-and-a-half-year contract, supporting reliable wastewater services for Oklahoma City and six neighboring communities.

P1.28.text: Jacobs extends role on German hydrogen-capable direct reduction plant

P1.29.text: Jacobs was selected to extend its role on thyssenkrupp Steel's direct reduction plant in Duisburg, Germany, continuing to provide project management office, construction management and assembly management services as the hydrogen-capable facility moves toward first iron production.

P1.30.text: Supporting safer, smoother travel across Georgia

P1.31.text: As transportation demands grow across metropolitan Atlanta, Jacobs will deliver roadway, bridge and safety improvements that keep people and goods moving. Discover how data-driven insights and construction expertise are supporting one of Georgia’s busiest transportation
